clauses.clause: Recording explains the airborne cure (subtitles); canister is a visible backpack, no slot, no slowdown, restored on death.
clauses.note: Both physical research approaches show the full airborne-agent subtitles and visible carried green cylinder/backpack at zoom0.5/1.5. Native grant preserves the entire weapon rack and checkpoint on the exact tick. Four120tick cardinal comparisons with/without only canister state have identical trajectory hashes and8.74976/8.75508m displacement; cure survives death in current checkpoint fixtures. Protected courier disclosed; no actor relocation.
